summary: Mangoceuticals, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement dated October 8, 2026 with certain investors for a registered direct offering: 657,000 shares plus accompanying common warrants to purchase up to 657,000 shares, priced at a combined $0.75 per share and warrant, for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $492,750. Warrants carry a $1.00 exercise price, are immediately exercisable, and expire in five years, with cashless exercise at a 1.08 multiplier and 4.99%/9.99% ownership caps. No placement agent was engaged; shares were offered under an effective Form S-3 shelf. Closing expected on or about October 9, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising takedown rather than a special situation; the warrant overhang and small raise size are the practical items to monitor.
